reuse.why: There is no shared category-selection helper in this tree to reuse; the change keeps using the existing getFixedGroupIds/hasSavedTemplates exclusions, but it does not introduce one either, so the selection query stays copied across actions.

duplication.why: The same `includeHiddenCategories ? '' : 'AND c.hidden = 0 AND g.hidden = 0'` SQL fragment and the same optional parameter are pasted into five copied queries, plus a sixth variant in copyPreviousMonth, instead of being decided once.

placement.why: The flag is handled in the action functions in server/budget/actions.ts where these actions live, though the hidden rule would better sit in one selection function there.

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions' signatures, their hidden filters and a release note change.

maintainability.why: The hidden rule now has six hand-maintained copies with an interpolated SQL conditional each, so any further change to which categories month-wide actions touch has to be repeated everywhere.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No shared selection abstraction exists in this tree for the actions to bypass; each action already ran its own query.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated fragment is pasted verbatim into setZero, set3MonthAvg, setLastMonthSpending, set12MonthAvg and set6MonthAvg, and expressed as a JS condition in copyPreviousMonth; it is open, not disguised.
